name: Bookmarks' page demo through Plugin Pages 2.4.7 in PageHostMode=Auto (registered at startup through its DI manager, no config.json): the links in Plugin Pages' drawer section and none of ours, the text/html shells rendered in its host with our title from the first frame, a second page, back and forward, parameters and a hard reload. Needs Plugin Pages (default or baseurl sandbox) and EnablePageDemo=true, PageHostMode=Auto at startup.

steps.name: frame probe in every document (probes/pages-probe.js)
open the login page
index.html carries Plugin Pages' tag
steps.waitFor: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => /<script plugin="PluginPages"/.test(t))

steps.name: reload, so the page has the tag
sign in as admin
Home shown and the Bookmarks script ran
warm-up: reload once after the sign-in, so the page starts with the signed-in user
Home shown again with the user known, the drawer's user menu built and the Bookmarks script ran
index.html: one Bookmarks tag, Plugin Pages' tag, the head fragment in Auto mode
steps.eval: fetch(new URL('index.html', location.href), { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.text()).then(t => { const s = t.match(/<script type="application\/json" data-jfbm-head data-jfbm-pages>([^<]*)<\/script>/); return { bookmarksTags: (t.match(/data-jfbm-plugin=/g) || []).length, headStyles: (t.match(/<style data-jfbm-head>/g) || []).length, headFragmentBeforeHeadEnd: t.indexOf('data-jfbm-head') < t.indexOf('</head>'), state: s ? JSON.parse(s[1]) : null, pluginPagesTag: /<script plugin="PluginPages"/.test(t) }; })
